# Voice fixtures

All clips are cut from **LibriVox "Short Poetry Collection 140"**
(https://archive.org/details/spc140_1502_librivox), which archive.org marks
**Public Domain Mark 1.0** (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/).
LibriVox recordings are in the public domain.

Each clip was converted to 16 kHz, 16 bit, mono WAV with ffmpeg, with no other
change. Readers are told apart by the initials in the LibriVox file names.
